data.name: ResumeHint
data.value: Returns the dispatch to its status before the hold and continues on the same machine. A dispatch held for a failed first-piece inspection returns to Pending FPI and must be measured again.

data.name: ResumeMachineDownHint
data.value: The machine is still down, so the dispatch cannot resume on it. Dispatches held because the machine went down resume automatically when the machine is available again. For urgent work, use Switch machine below.

data.name: ResumeNeedsQualityHint
data.value: This dispatch was held for a quality failure. It can only be resumed by QC staff with update permission on inspection orders.

data.name: SwitchHintNone
data.value: Nothing produced yet: the whole dispatch moves to the selected machine and returns to Pending. It needs a new setup and first-piece inspection. Rescheduling keeps it on this machine.

data.name: SwitchHintPartial
data.value: {0} done: this dispatch closes at the quantity done, and the remaining {1} goes to a new continuation dispatch on the selected machine. It needs a new setup and first-piece inspection. Rescheduling keeps it on this machine.

data.name: NoSwitchMachine
data.value: No other machine in this plant is available for production.

data.name: ShortCloseHintPartial
data.value: The remaining quantity will not be produced: this dispatch completes at {0}. When all other dispatches of the work order are finished, the work order completes.

data.name: ShortCloseHintNone
data.value: Nothing produced yet: the dispatch becomes Cancelled and no longer appears in the shop-floor list.

data.name: ShortCloseConfirm
data.value: Stop producing the remaining {0}? This cannot be undone.
